memoryAssessment.basis: Current checkpoint/base/published22/ownership and two scoped groups reliably distinguished from previous completed task. No unresolved source/version/authorization conflict. Preparation and scoped follow-through safe from current short card.
memoryAssessment.concreteRisk: Previous MAPSF had stale-control probes after configuration recreation; they were explicitly excluded/corrected. Do not carry old Use-button scenarios into new click-commit policy.
mitigation: Wait for completion and inspect exitCode before any dependent action.
After app/page/config switch obtain fresh snapshot before target lookup; stop dependent chain if target missing or prior step failed.
Validate actual frame content and callback/data effects, never infer PASS from frame name.
Checkpoint at unit/build/native/differential/cleanup stages; escalate if repeated recovery mistakes or source conflicts prevent reliable continuation.
memoryAssessment.handoff: Recommended before any broader task; no required takeover signal now. Do not create chat/agent or edit central registry.

policyChanges: Latest user rule: valid point selection commits chosen point once and returns; old second Use confirmation is superseded.
Point selection never automatically creates a ride, pays, or submits an outer profile/favorite form. Keep original order/payment/cancel confirmations.
Do not count previous MAPSF picker-flow PASS for the changed selection behavior. Only exact unchanged code/tests may be inherited with explicit source attribution.

groups.scope: Place selection, history feedback and waypoints
unitCases: Run relevant new PlaceSelection JUnit and affected existing owner/query/manualGPS/modal rule tests against exact freeze.
Known valid history/common point and synthetic search callback commit exactly once; repeated tap/duplicate callback cannot write twice.
Missing/NaN/infinite/out-of-range coordinates show actionable feedback or start required lookup, never silently return or fabricate0 coordinates. Explicit valid coordinates follow existing contract.
Account/query/target generation change, cancellation and old asynchronous callbacks cannot update wrong caller draft.
nativeCases: Known historical/common point click immediately returns correct name/coordinates/metadata; no obsolete Use button.
Invalid/unknown historical point has visible feedback, stays usable and preserves prior draft until valid selection.
Destination page owns waypoint entry; add/edit/remove/order up to2 points; max limit enforced without silently losing existing points.
New and pre-existing pickup/destination/waypoint/favorite contexts: return with no selection or cancel leaves caller unchanged.
Repeated taps and pending-search→cancel/return have at most one correct selection; search-stub callback may be proven in pure rule tests when actual provider unavailable.
Original booking confirmation and necessary payment/cancel confirmations remain reachable; choosing a point alone sends no order/payment.

groups.scope: Shared mature/simple visual style, representative screens only
nativeCases: Passenger representative home, order, profile; driver home, trip/order, profile, wallet at normal size. Compare shared typography/colors/button hierarchy/spacing/list treatment against frozen design intent.
360x640dp/font1.3 and real keyboard on relevant input/selection form: no clipped important labels, unreachable final action, or misleading disabled/primary states.
Necessary confirmation dialogs retain readable full labels and equal usable actions; opening/closing restores caller.
Representative map panel/fullscreen and modal/page scope smoke only where shared styling affects them; keep visible restoration controls/header/tabs. No repeat of old full native matrix.

afterFreeze: Root exact40SHA/version/committed product then fresh external export; do not build active dirty tree.
Relevant actual unit tests, both original APK builds and isolatedQA builds; source/version/package/priorSigner/HTTPS/private-value scans.
Fresh dedicated official-tools AVD/local fixture/identities/data; reuse verified generic tooling only, not old data or obsolete scenario expectations.
Native actual frames+XML and callback/local synthetic effects tagged with precise source; preserve FAIL and differential fixes.
Cleanup exact own emulator/fixture/reverse, save final proof/review/short card and run memory gate; root alone merge/releases.

preflight.source: HEAD basec261; author has uncommitted product changes; only metadata status inspected, no product review/copy/build.

notStarted: No AVD definition/boot/fixture/TLS/private identity or data creation
excluded: Old full ride/payment lifecycle and unrelated old UI matrices
